title: Unbridled Midnight Cravings Peruvian Gochujang Suspiro-Limeno
description: A rich, springy Peruvian dish featuring gochujang, yuzu-cure, and satvik-friendly ingredients, served in a corn-husk wrap.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, yuzu juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the grouper fillet to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the grouper from the marinade and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the corn husks on the grill or in a dry pan until lightly charred.
Mash the avocado oil, yuzu zest, and crushed plantain chips together in a small bowl.
Once the grouper is cooked, wrap each fillet in a toasted corn husk and top with the mashed avocado mixture.
Garnish with dried cilantro and serve immediately.
